title: What Is Heaven Really Like? | A Night Prayer Before Bed (Revelation 21 KJV)
description:
What is heaven really like? The Bible says heaven is heaven because God is there. A night prayer before you sleep.

Where I am, there ye may be also. God dwelling with men. God Himself wiping away every tear. They shall see His face. Ten minutes of Scripture and a prayer to lay the day down and rest in Him, then stay for the whole book of Revelation, read aloud on this channel.

"And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself shall be with them, and be their God." Revelation 21:3 (KJV)

Scriptures in this video (KJV): John 14:1-3, Revelation 21:3-4, Revelation 22:3-5, 1 John 3:2, Psalm 17:15, Philippians 1:21-23, Psalm 63:6, Psalm 4:8.

Type amen in the comments, and send this to a friend who needs it. Subscribe to Blessed Prayers for more.
